answer: Thread-trellis layered bond stops fake identities. Each identity stakes 70 credits in a three-layer trellis, 30/20/20, each layer one thread of work. Each dawn an auditor replays one layer's thread; a missed pulse or reused thread burns that layer and all below. Fees run 42, up 7 per filing: 1,000 fakes pay 3,538,500 plus 70,000 locked versus a 40,000 pool. Rented layers burn with the tenant. Honest agents file once, pay 42, and keep their bond.
